hero.title: Manage Your Tech Repair Business From One Smart Platform.
hero.description: Garfix keeps branches, customers, devices, service orders, technicians, and evidence aligned inside one calm workspace.

dashboard.title: One view for the whole shop

scope.title: Scoped access
scope.description: Admins control the full operation while technicians only see the work that belongs to their branch.

updates.title: No more scattered updates
updates.description: Repairs, notes, files, and customer status stay in one place.

branches.title: Cleaner branch control
branches.description: Each branch keeps its own technicians, customers, and service flow.

desk.title: A calmer front desk
desk.description: Intake, tracking, and delivery feel organized instead of reactive.

features.title: Less friction. Better repair operations.
features.description: Every block is designed to reduce noise at the desk, on the bench, and across the business.

branchCatalogs.title: Branch-specific catalogs
branchCatalogs.description: Statuses, devices, locations, customers, and technicians stay scoped to the right branch.

repairTracking.title: Repair order tracking
repairTracking.description: Move every device from intake to delivery with clear history, technician assignment, and status.

roles.title: Role-based access
roles.description: Admins see the full operation. Technicians only see what they need to work.

dashboards.title: Owner dashboards
dashboards.description: See branch load, active repairs, and delivery progress without digging for data.

workflow.title: A repair flow the whole team can follow.
workflow.description: From receiving a device to delivering it back, the process stays simple and readable.

receive.title: Receive
receive.description: Create the job and register the device.

assign.title: Assign
assign.description: Route the job to the right technician and branch.

repair.title: Repair
repair.description: Track status, notes, costs, and evidence.

deliver.title: Deliver
deliver.description: Close with full history ready for future visits.

branches.title: Each branch feels local. The business still feels unified.
branches.description: Admins can create branches, assign technicians, and monitor services without mixing the daily work of one location with another.

items.customers: Customers and devices stay tied to the correct branch
items.technicians: Technicians work inside their own operational scope
items.realtime: Switching branches refreshes service views in real time

pricing.title: Choose the plan that matches your repair floor.
pricing.description: Simple plans for single-shop teams, growing branch networks, and larger operations.
pricing.currencyNote: USD values are estimated from the configured MXN exchange rate.

BASIC.name: Basic
BASIC.tagline: For small shops that want order
BASIC.description: Control intake, customers, devices, work orders, and evidence from one place.

PRO.name: Pro
PRO.description: Coordinate technicians, branch-specific catalogs, repair queues, and dashboards without losing control.

ENTERPRISE.name: Enterprise
ENTERPRISE.tagline: For networks with serious service volume
ENTERPRISE.description: Operate a full repair network with stronger visibility, control, and scale.

finalCta.title: Run a calmer repair business with less chasing and more clarity.
finalCta.description: Get started, choose a plan, and set up your main branch in minutes.
